leaves.name: katoHTExists
leaves.doc: R13, existence form (ht-exists): for a newform f of weight k >= 2, level N and every l, iota_C, iota_L there is a semisimple continuous rho : G_Q -> GL_2(Qbar_l), unramified outside N l, whose geometric Frobenius at p not dividing N l has trace a_p(f), and whose restriction to G_{Q_l} is Hodge-Tate with weights {0, k - 1} (cyclotomic weight -1). Kato 2004 sections 9.2-9.4 and 11.3 for V_{F_lambda}(f) itself (cohomological normalization, every level); the dualization (HTDual, from Tate 1967) and the transport to every semisimple attached rho (Chebotarev, Brauer-Nesbitt, invariance of HT weights under conjugation) are proved in Lean. Replaces eigenformHTNew.
